body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized handheld digital camera, 57 mm wide, 39 mm tall, 33 mm deep. Use image[1] for the exact proportions, the 3/4 front view from slightly above and the feature layout: lens with a 16 mm ring right of centre at 41 % of the height, small square flash window upper left, round shutter button and a small slide switch on the top left above the grip, USB-C port on the right side face. Concept 'Retro compact': a 1960s pocket camera reinterpreted for 3D printing, two-tone with a dark finely textured band wrapping the middle and light-grey top and bottom plates. Details: a stepped lens barrel with fine knurling and a bezel ring, a small rectangular flash window with prism ridges, a shutter button with a threaded collar, a mini slide switch, a curved finger rest on the front left, small vent slits in the bottom plate, tiny engraved icons. Matte light-grey 3D-printed PLA with dark-grey accents, crisp edges, clean part lines, believable to 3D print. One camera fully in frame, centered, seamless pure white background, soft neutral studio light, sharp focus, high detail. --no text, logos, screen, viewfinder hump, extra lenses, hands, people, strap
